The parties acknowledge that the description of the Services is intended to identify the principal workstreams. Minor clarifications may be made through ordinary project communications, provided that such clarification does not materially increase the workload.
findings.explanation: It allows the client to request minor clarifications without a formal change order, which could be used to obtain additional work at no extra cost.
findings.suggested_change: Any clarification or modification to the Services shall be documented in a written change order that specifies any additional fees or schedule adjustments.

findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: The client can end the contract instantly and you may not receive payment for work already performed.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' written notice, and the Contractor shall be paid for all Services performed up to the effective termination date.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of the work passes to the client as soon as it is delivered, even if you have not yet been paid.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client upon full payment of the applicable invoice for that Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a couple of small adjustments before signing:

- The relevant clause allows termination without notice and without further payment. To ensure fair compensation, I propose that either party may terminate for convenience upon thirty (30) days' written notice, and the Contractor shall be paid for all services performed up to the effective termination date.
- The relevant clause transfers all intellectual property rights to the Client upon delivery. I suggest that the rights transfer upon full payment of the applicable invoice for each deliverable.

Thank you for considering these changes. I look forward to moving ahead.

Best regards
